messages:
jess: Noticed Prometheus WAL pressure and a big jump in remote_write throughput after the DCGM exporter bump. Head series roughly tripled.
omar: yup. DCGM started exporting per-process metrics for every GPU process on host. cardinality exploded.
sasha: which release? did we flip some default?
jess: v2.4.0 -> v2.4.1 rolled yesterday. New behavior emits gpu_process_* series with pid/process_name labels by default.
mike: that explains the billing spike. remote_write costs shot up overnight.
ops-bot: Alert: prom_remote_write_bandwidth > 120MB/min (cluster-gpu) - firing
jess: short term mitigation options:
- add metrics_relabel_configs in the ServiceMonitor to drop per-process labels
- reduce node scrape_interval to 60s for GPU nodes
- write_relabel_configs in Prometheus to drop gpu_process_* before sending
- flip exporter flag --proc-export=false in the DaemonSet

I can draft the ServiceMonitor relabel snippet.
omar: drop snippet plz, I can push a patch fast.
jess: here you go (to add under the ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor):

```
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["gpu_process_name","gpu_process_pid"]
    regex: ".+"
    action: drop
```

and in Prometheus (prometheus-operator values) put:

```
write_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__name__"]
    regex: "gpu_process_.*"
    action: drop
```

That avoids sending those high-cardinality series to remote_write.
sasha: also consider using relabel to remove per-process labels rather than dropping entire metrics, in case we still want per-device totals.
mike: agree, drop the labels is better.
jess: Another quick hack: if we detect a spike, annotate the dcgm pods with prometheus.io/scrape: 'false' temporarily. But this is heavy-handed.
omar: I'll prepare a small rollout: (1) add metric_relabel to ServiceMonitor, (2) add write_relabel in values.yaml, (3) patch DaemonSet args to --proc-export=false and roll.
mike: can we gate the rollout with an alert-based rollback? if series_count > baseline*1.2 after deploy, auto-roll back.
sasha: we have a promql that approximates series delta, something like:

```
expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_head_series_added_total[5m]) > 1000
```

But that'll need tuning per-cluster.
jess: I'll include a temporary alert with a 5m for for now. Also adding a Grafana panel for remote_write bytes and head_series count on the infra dashboard.
omar: staging run looks promising: series down ~68% after relabel and exporter flag. Remote_write bytes down ~60%.
mike: great. schedule prod rollout at 03:00 UTC when traffic is low. I'll watch invoices and alerts.
sasha: follow up: add an integration test in our infra repo that runs a fake exporter exposing per-process labels and asserts Prometheus configs drop them unless opt-in.
jess: putting PR: https://git.internal/infra/patches/489 - includes ServiceMonitor metric_relabel, prometheus values write_relabel, and DaemonSet arg toggle. staging pass.
ops-bot: Deployment jess/dcgm-fix created (namespace infra)
omar: rolling to prod now.
ops-bot: Alert resolved: prom_remote_write_bandwidth (cluster-gpu) - OK
mike: billing dashboard trending down, WAL pressure normalized. thanks everyone.
sasha: we should add a short runbook note about cardinality risks when upgrading exporters and remind owners to check write_relabel_configs.
jess: will add runbook entry and a postmortem note. closing thread.
